purpose: Resolve only the Phi-4 chat-parser/JSON-grammar initialization incompatibility observed in E0C V1, without using semantic scores or any external evaluation rows to select a repair.
known_v1_failure_classes: long displayed prompts were abbreviated by llama-cli, so the exact-prompt output extractor missed valid terminal JSON
Phi-4 native chat parsing passed the assistant generation prompt through the JSON grammar and failed sampler initialization
probe_case_reuse: Use the already-frozen harmless V1 case bytes; do not add or tune a semantic example.

ordered_candidates.rationale: Smallest compatibility change: retain the embedded Jinja template and frozen JSON schema while preventing auxiliary chat-content parsing from consuming the generation prompt.
Retain syntax-constrained output but avoid the Jinja parser path if the first repair fails.
Last resort: preserve the frozen prompts and exact strict parser while removing only constrained decoding.

selection_rule: evaluate candidates in frozen priority order
for each candidate require two successful independent CPU processes
require a terminal JSON object accepted by the already-frozen strict V2 parser
require nonce non-disclosure, active embedded chat template, zero logged GPU layers, and byte-identical replay
do not inspect or use the parsed numeric scores for candidate selection
stop at the first candidate satisfying every operational condition
